items.title: Cedar Walton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: And Madame Chambers was layin' for us, right at the door.

ctx.x: So we carved a hole in the fence and went over and got our peaches. And Madame Chambers was layin' for us, right at the door. "I see you, I see you, all of you." That was another time when he disciplined me. There were only two times I violated his, you know, his authority. So uh, so where are we now? In Dallas or family or racial? Yeah, it's all, all, all of it self- contained.
